events.text:
## Recommendation

- **Ratings for boat salmon this week:** Grand Haven 1, Muskegon 1, South Haven 1, St. Joseph 0. All four were slow in the newest reports, so none rates above below-average.
- **Go to Grand Haven** (Muskegon is a close second). Troll 90-180 ft of water with fish 45-100 ft down, using glow plugs, glow spoons, or meat rigs.
- **Skip St. Joseph** for now. Its newest boat report said anglers had a hard time locating fish.
- **Check the wind before you go.** I couldn't get a wind forecast or the modeled cold-layer depth for this week.

## Why

- **Grand Haven and Muskegon edge out the others:** the Aug 23 reports from both were slow, but they were the only boat reports that named working lures and depths, and the water there was the coolest (about 67 F).
- **St. Joseph rates lowest:** its Aug 23 boat report said anglers had a hard time locating fish, and its water was the warmest (about 72 F).
- **I'd expect this to stay a scattered bite:** the buoy temperatures show no fresh cold-water push this week, and the good boat reports came after sharp drops (Aug 16).

## Evidence

**Recent reports (newest is Aug 23, six days old)**
- Grand Haven (Aug 23): boat quality 0 (slow). "The best action for salmon was 45 to 100 down in 90 to 180 feet of water. … Glow plugs, glow spoons and meat rigs all worked well."
- Muskegon (Aug 23): boat quality 0 (slow). "Anglers found a few salmon 40 to 100 feet down in 70 to 150 feet of water. … Glow plugs and glow spoons performed well."
- South Haven (Aug 23): boat quality 0 (slow). "The best fishing was in around 100 feet of water. … The fish were very scattered."
- St. Joseph (Aug 23): boat quality 0 (slow). "Salmon anglers had a hard time locating fish."
- Earlier, Aug 16 boat reports were good at Grand Haven, Muskegon and South Haven (quality 3), after a sharp buoy temperature drop. Aug 16 St. Joseph was only quality 1.

**Past seasons (history, not current)**
- In late August weeks with surface water near 68 F, boat results ranged from 0 to 3. The good weeks (Grand Haven 2023-08-16, Muskegon 2023-08-16, South Haven 2023-08-16) followed sharp temperature drops. The slow weeks had little or no drop (Grand Haven 2023-08-23, St. Joseph 2023-08-23).

**Conditions now (buoy surface water, week before Aug 29)**
- St. Joseph 72 F (-1 F over the week); South Haven 70 F (-1 F); Grand Haven 67 F (0 F); Muskegon 67 F (0 F).
- These are measured buoy readings. The live feed was unavailable, so this is the most recent week I could get.

## Caveats

- The newest boat reports are from Aug 23, six days old. Conditions can change quickly this time of year.
- I had no wind forecast and no modeled cold-layer depth, so I can't say whether an upwelling is coming.
- Ratings are my judgment from the newest reports and the history above, not a DNR rating.
- The Aug 23 reports list no pier-only details for Muskegon or South Haven, so the pier picture is unclear.

## Sources

- Aug 23 bulletin: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/36c669b
- Aug 16 bulletin: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/36b27d5
- Aug 9 bulletin: https://content.govdelivery.com/accounts/MIDNR/bulletins/369e344
